description: This file is the entry point and configuration for an ASP.NET Core application integrated with Orleans. It sets up hosting, Orleans clustering, health checks, and background services, and includes internal Orleans health check and grain implementation classes.

classes.name: OrleansHealthCheck
classes.description: Implements a health check for verifying the status of an Orleans silo node within the cluster.

classes.name: LoadDriverBackgroundService
classes.description: A background service that periodically performs ping operations on a grain to simulate load.

classes.name: RebalancingTestGrain
classes.description: A simple Grain implementing IRebalancingTestGrain interface, used for testing rebalancing; marked with collection age limit attribute.

methods.name: CheckHealthAsync
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous health check of the Orleans silo by querying cluster membership status.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: A no-op method intended for health testing of the grain.
